notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW - Senna Forever Expansion Pack
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608540/Horizon_Chase_Turbo__Senna_Forever/][img]https://i.imgur.com/ocxwGfm.jpeg[/img][/url]

Ayrton Senna was a legendary Brazilian driver who changed history – his name is still commonly remembered as one of the most iconic racers of all time.

[b]Senna Forever[/b], our largest DLC to date, is a tribute to honor his memory, and it is already available for you to relive his steps in a nostalgia-driven arcade-style racing game.

[previewyoutube=3JtRXs-_Psg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Horizon Chase Turbo: Senna Forever[/b] debuts an entirely new set of cars, tracks, and features inspired by Senna – which, by the way, is all thanks to the partnership and support of Senna Brands. Part of the profits obtained with the expansion will also be dedicated to support Ayrton Senna’s Institute educational programs.

The Feature Trailer below shows just a little bit of everything we’ve packed for you, check it out!

[previewyoutube=0lXzWHUaW2w;full][/previewyoutube]
Career Mode? Championship Mode? Senna's Marks? New exclusive skins? Multiplayer? You name it, we got it. If you heard a familiar tune in this trailer, your ears are also quite right, because it was made by our dearest Barry Leitch, the very same composer for the soundtrack of the main game. The expansion also features tailor-made new tracks for you too!

[h1]Career Mode[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/A9Ir9Le.jpg[/img]
Imagine you impersonating Senna in first-person view gameplay, in a campaign specially focused on some of the biggest moments of his journey to glory? - that’s the [b]Career Mode[/b], the main feature of this expansion. Play in 5 different chapters, each with a set number of key races based on his life career - oh, there are also his own achievements, which we call Senna’s Marks, that you can complete here as well!

[h1]First Person View[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9xTe0U5.jpg[/img]
For the first time ever, you’ll get to feel the heat of the moment from the inside of a cockpit in Horizon Chase Turbo with this [b]brand-new first-person view[/b], a feature exclusive to this expansion.

[h1]Race Strategies[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ORiVud1.jpg[/img]
Normally, in Horizon Chase Turbo, you’d have a selection of cars to choose from. Only this time, you’re Senna, so you’re using cars inspired by the ones he drove. To maintain the strategy, there’s a new mechanic before each game where you’ll have to pick your focus: [b]Enhanced Tires, Advanced Aerodynamics, or Special Fuel[/b].

[h1]New cars and skins[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bhdIMuD.jpg[/img]
Of course [b]new cars[/b] are also coming! There are 6 new ones coming to the Career Mode and also 34 different other playable cars to choose from on Championship Mode. Fancy, huh?

[h1]Championship Mode[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8emn5PT.png[/img]
If you’re worried about the replayability of this game, the [b]Championship Mode[/b] has you covered. There’s 18 different teams to choose from and more than 30 cars to unlock. There are three categories depending on what kind of challenge you’re looking for and also randomized competitors, tracks and weather so you’ll never know what’s coming.

[h1]Local Multiplayer[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yJxXbnr.jpg[/img]
If you already play Horizon Chase Turbo, this might be an old acquaintance for you. But if you don’t, maybe you remember, as kids, when we used to all sit together on the couch to play, right? 
That feeling is brought back in this expansion! You can play [b]Horizon Chase Turbo: Senna Forever[/b] with up to 4 local players, also with randomized stuff from the Championship Mode. But the snacks are on you!

Are you thrilled for this expansion? Because we certainly are. Purchase [b]Senna Forever[/b] now and secure your place in the starting grid!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608540/Horizon_Chase_Turbo__Senna_Forever

notes.title: ROOKIE SERIES WELCOMES NEW PLAYERS TO HORIZON CHASE TURBO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600331/70e524928d2e9d2bfbcf53b1a1d858bfd1b7a6b0.png[/img]

[b]Horizon Chase Turbo[/b] gets a new campaign tailored for new players! [b]Bring your friends and family[/b] together into[b] Rookie Series, a free DLC [/b]that's [b]now available for Steam! 
[/b]
This new campaign is directed at inexperienced players, as it will teach the game basics in a welcoming environment, where they can evolve at their own pace. [b]With no leaderboards, collectible coins nor fuel management[/b], the DLC lets players focus on learning the main aspects of racing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600331/a66747081959585db601e4de46958c9169ee9db4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Main features:[/h1]
- A brand new Rookie car
- 24 selected races from the World Tour Mode (2 races per location)
- 12 cars racing in each track with a less aggressive AI (World Tour has 20 cars in each race)
- No leaderboards, collectible coins nor fuel management
- Finishing a race in any position unlocks the next track
- By finishing every race, the player gets a Golden Driver’s License

[h1][b]ROOKIE: A PERFECT CAR FOR BEGINNERS[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600331/ce4b652b479baa8f1a249de6ad3694c4aa4460fe.jpg[/img]

Horizon Chase Turbo: Rookie Series unlocks[b] Rookie, a brand new car that is perfect for players who don’t have much experience with racing games.[/b] It offers great handling and receives automatic upgrades as the player progresses in the campaign. 

[h1][b]TAKE YOUR DRIVER'S LICENSE[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600331/5d668aaa1100bf49d3e7e1ed97e812604d48c39f.png[/img]

When the players reach the end of Rookie Series, they’ll [b]unlock a special Golden Driver’s License[/b], that ensures they’re ready for World Tour and other gaming modes. With the new Rookie Series campaign DLC and our complete local multiplayer mode, [b]we hope to bring friends and families together to enjoy everything Horizon Chase Turbo has to offer.[/b]
[b]
See you in the finish line![/b]

Summer Vibes, HORIZON CHASE TURBO first DLC is now available on Steam. Now you can drive the most classic arcade roadster through sunny roads.

notes.title: OUR BEST TIME UNTIL NOW: 1 YEAR OF HORIZON CHASE TURBO.
notes.content:
[b]Our birthday month gifts to you: Playground Mode 2.0, 2 limited unlockable skins and our biggest SALE ever. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/b33e9fef7dc362ddaa207c6cd0a8138f78aa51b3.png[/img]

A decent birthday party always have some gifts, right? Well, this one is focused on our players' community. But first let's look back and review the road we raced together in this last great year:

- Besides tons of great reviews we reached Top 4 Racing Games on Steam in 2018

- We launched a New Playground Mode, bringing new stuff twice a month (new tracks, cars and challenges). 

- Almost 7 MILLION races started by our Steam players.

But enough of the past and let's start looking forward. Take a look at our anniversary pack with many gifts to you:
[b]
SALE 40% OFF[/b]
The biggest discount ever: 40% in all platforms, limited time. Tell your friends and after they purchase challenge them to a duel!

[b]PLAYGROUND MODE 2.0  WITH LIMITED SKINS [/b]
A new and competitive Playground, where you can collect coins and purchase new content. For this event, we have a pair of exclusive skins, limited to our anniversary month. Pick yours right now, while you can!

[b]ANNIVERSARY SEASONS [/b]
Two freakin' epic seasons bringing back the most classic(and loved) tracks with new challenges,  featuring collectible coins, duels and time attacks. You gotta try Playground Mode right away.
[b]
WORDS FROM THE PLAYERS:[/b]

"My entire family was OBSESSED with Horizon Chase Turbo! All three of my kids (then 10, 6, and 2), my wife and I, my sister-in-law, my mother-in-law. The Horizon Chase Turbo soundtrack and Taylor Swift are the most requested driving music." [b](@StephenBallNC, Steam User)[/b]

"Like the game a lot - as amateur-driver 😎 - I am not the fastest driver, but the fun with the new Playgrounds keep me playing". [b](@Aotearoas, Steam User) [/b]

“ Fast paced, old-school arcade racing game with lots of action!
LOVE IT! 10/10."[b] (@psidex, Steam User) [/b]

You think that's enough? Far from it. Besides Playground 2.0, we're working in new game modes and new DLCs including a new car, a new campaign and more. 

We'd like to thank our players' community and everyone who raced with us. 

After all, it's not just about crossing the finish line, it's about sharing the road.

Keep speeding with us.

notes.title: NOSSO MELHOR TEMPO ATÉ AGORA: 1 ANO DE HORIZON CHASE TURBO.
notes.content:
[b]O mês de aniversário tem foco total em você: Modo Playground 2.0, duas Skins Exclusivas desbloqueáveis e nossa maior SALE da história.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/b33e9fef7dc362ddaa207c6cd0a8138f78aa51b3.png[/img]

Aniversário bom tem que ter presente. Que nesse caso é para quem correu muito por nós: você, que faz parte da nossa comunidade de Horizon Chasers. Mas primeiro vamos relembrar um pouco do que aconteceu nesse ano:

- Lançamos o novo modo Playground, que traz uma nova temática a cada quinzena (novas pistas, carros e desafios). 

- Criamos muito conteúdo incluindo surpresas, como o Carro da Firma inspirado nos memes.

- Foram quase 7 MILHÕES de largadas só entre os nossos jogadores da Steam.

Mas não adianta ficar falando só do passado, no presente temos um pack de aniversário que vem com muitas novidades para você:

[b]SALE 40% OFF[/b]
O maior desconto que já oferecemos: 40% em todas as plataformas, por tempo limitado! Quem não comprou ainda, agora não tem mais desculpas meu chapa. É o momento de avisar aquele seu amigo "mão fechada" e finalmente vocês poderão descobrir quem é o mais rápido!
[b]
MODO PLAYGROUND 2.0 COM 2 SKINS EXCLUSIVAS[/b]
Um novo Playground ainda mais competitivo e divertido, onde você pode coletar moedas especiais e desbloquear novos conteúdos exclusivos. Dessa vez são duas  skins comemorativas por tempo limitado.
[b]
ANNIVERSARY SEASONS [/b]
Duas seasons épicas de aniversário no Modo Playground trazendo de volta algumas das pistas preferidas(e mais jogadas) pela galera com direito a moedas coletáveis, duelos e time attacks.Já foi lá testar? 
[b]
COM A PALAVRA, HORIZON CHASERS.[/b]

“Simplesmente perfeito! Me senti de volta ao início dos anos 90 jogando Top Gear no meu Super Nintendo...trilha sonora perfeita! bons gráficos, jogabilidade muito boa, quem é fã de games de corrida irá amar, principalmente se você cresceu jogando Top Gear! Game 10, Nostalgia 10!!!”
[b](Flavio Branford, Usuário Steam)[/b]

“A Aquiris com Horizon Chase tenta reviver nos corações dos fãs de Top Gear toda aquela nostalgia e desafios que tínhamos com o game dos anos 90, você praticamente tem total referência de Top Gear bem como a trilha sonora, carros, pistas, porém agora com desafios diferentes para desbloquear peças para os carros, além de diversos carros para se desbloquear, pistas extras, carros com referências nacionais, obviamente que tudo isso tentando equilibrar nostalgia com um gameplay mais moderno.” [b](Saw, Usuário Steam)[/b]

“O jogo me motivou para seguir sempre vencendo mesmo com muitos desafios e pistas para enfrentar esse jogo demonstrou um gráfico lindo, muitas pistas, muitos países, tudo lindo tudo especial bem era arcade mesmo. Os prêmios são bem legais, o tema do Top Gear do compositor Barry Leitch e sensacional me encheu de lágrimas de ver uma música tão melhorada que me fez passar no tempo que era criança e jogando no super nintendo de locadora essa nostalgia maravilhosa.” [b](Spike, Usuário Steam)
[/b]

“Horizon Chase Turbo é indispensável para todos aqueles que curtem corrida, inclusive os que preferem os simuladores. Apesar de sua ação arcade, há muito desafio aguardando os aficionados por velocidade, e que, entre uma partida ou outra de Forza ou Gran Turismo, encontrarão nas corridas rápidas do game um lugar de diversão e lazer.” [b](Leo, Usuário Steam)[/b]

E vem mais novidades pela frente, a estrada é longa! Além do Playground 2.0, vem aí novos modos de jogo e DLCs inéditos que incluem um novo carro, uma nova campanha e muito mais.   

Todas essas novidades são uma forma de agradecer a você, que acelerou ao nosso lado e nos fez chegar até aqui.

Afinal de contas, não é apenas sobre cruzar a linha de chegada, é sobre compartilhar a estrada.

Continue pisando fundo conosco.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Gameplay improvements and achievement fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/f6d6506965372d546ab053d4f41cdb496a567322.png[/img]

Hello there!

Hope you're all having as great a time as we are playing Horizon Chase Turbo since it launched. We'd also like to thank all players who helped us with feedbacks and bug reports--you guys are amazing and help us make the game even better! 

We spent the past weeks reviewing some pesky bugs (particularly regarding achievements, since we know how important these are to you!) along with balancing issues found in the game after launch. You can find the breakdown below.

Please keep the feedback coming and let us know of any persisting issues. Don't forget to check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/389140/discussions/0/1693795812309262989/]FAQ[/url] to see if there's a solution there and how to contact us so we can best help you sort it out if there isn't.


[h1][b]Improvements and Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Improved overall game performance and reduced hiccups during gameplay.
    [*]General improvements on balance, learning curve and collision handling.
    [*]Changed wording of “Bonus Races” to “Upgrade Races” to improve communication. Behavior of Upgrade Races and rules for obtaining upgrades remain the same.

[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed handling of “Comeback” achievement so that it is awarded if the player gets out of fuel at any point during the race instead of only if they finish the race with an empty tank.
    [*]Fixed “Marathonist” and “Transporter” achievements’ progress not being saved between game sessions.
    [*]Fixed issue that caused “Retry race” confirmation popup to get stuck in some cases.
    [*]Fixed finish line being positioned in the wrong place in the in-game minimap for some tracks.

[/list]

[h1][b]One more![/b][/h1]
[list]
   [*]People have been reporting issues with the Marathonist achievement being stuck at a certain mileage even after the patch. This is fixed now, so the Marathonist counter should be updating now.
[/list]

[h1][b]Quick hotfix in 06/20/18[/b][/h1]
[list]
   [*]We fixed an issue that had some players start the game from scratch with the California cup locked.
[/list]

As always, thanks for the support so far, and let us know if you still got any issues.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/117e235dc29c86d1498182e086732ee248fb8140.png[/img]
Hi guys!

First of all, thank you for the amazing reception since we launched Horizon Chase Turbo! The reviews have been great and we're thrilled to see you enjoy the experience we worked so hard to create :)

We've just updated the game with fixes for several issues that came up since the game launched.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue that resetted custom key bindings to default whenever the game was closed.
    [*]Fixed an issue with leaderboards visualization, in which players under 50th would always appear as the 50th place in the boards.
    [*]Fixed issues with the virtual keyboard losing focus in multiplayer setup screen.
    [*]Fixed achievements only appearing after the game was closed.
    [*]Fixed “Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger” achievement being awarded with only one upgrade. If you got it that way, lucky you. Early birds get the worm.
    [*]Fixed an issue that could prevent the "Round the Globe" and "Golden Passport" achievements from unlocking in some cases. If you already beat the game and were affected by this issue, please finish the "Kilauea - Final Challenge" track again (in 5th place or better) to see the World Tour ending and the missing trophies should unlock correctly.
[/list]

[h1][b]Some more bug fixes - May 18th[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed Pause button not working after you change or reset key bindings.
    [*]Fixed an issue with save games that prevented the player from getting past the title screen. Some players reported it as keyboard/controllers not working anymore. They were the same and should be working now.
    [*]Fixed Endurance mode changing your car if you played another game mode in-between sessions.
[/list]

[h1][b]One more - May 21th[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some issues in input config screen. Controls were resetting to blank when players chose to reset to default, and not reacting to changing between keyboard/controller.
[/list]

If you find anything else that's preventing you from playing, please let us know through [b]support@aquiris.com.br[/b], with as much information as you can. We'll keep looking for any pesky bugs that may have slipped through!
